_comment: SYNTHETIC, written by hand around the SHAPE of a Trader Joe's strip — no card digits, no cashier, no phone number, because the repo is public. Three photos overlapping two lines at each seam, and each seam falls on an item AND its count sub-row so the pair travels together. Nearly every line carries a count; NUTRITIONAL YEAST is printed twice at the same figure, which is two lines and never one counted twice. The strip prints NO subtotal — the lines plus the printed tax come to the printed $104.45 — and `Items in Transaction` and `Balance to pay` are bookkeeping, not lines.
